_README: Everything on the site comes from this file. Edit here, commit, done — no HTML to touch. Dates are YYYY-MM; use "present" for an end date that is still running, and durations work themselves out. Roles inside a company go newest first.

profile.name: Md Sohanur Rahman
profile.headline: Senior Data Analyst & Team Lead | Technical Author & Trainer

contacts.label: Role
contacts.value: Team Lead, Data & Analytics at V2 Technologies

hello: Hi, I am a Senior Data Analyst and Team Lead with 7+ years across data analytics, business intelligence and data engineering. For the last three of them I have led the Data & Analytics team of seven at V2 Technologies. I work on the full path from raw data to decisions: designing databases and data warehouses, building ETL pipelines with dbt and Airflow on BigQuery and PostgreSQL, modeling the data — from forecasting and marketing mix models to machine learning — and delivering the Power BI, Tableau and Excel reporting that management actually uses.

I currently lead data and analytics for EveryAI, an AI subscription app with 500K+ users, and the rebuild of BAT Bangladesh's 8-year-old e-CRM platform. Other clients include Grameenphone, Unilever Bangladesh, City Bank and Nagad. Alongside the client work I write and teach — I am the author of Math for Programmers and spent two years as a data analytics instructor. As a Mathematics graduate I lean on that background every day, and I am open to remote work and relocation.
resumeIntro: I lead a team of seven analysts and engineers — planning and tracking work across client projects, reviewing SQL, models and dashboards, mentoring the juniors and reporting to management. Alongside the leadership I stay hands-on: building ETL/ELT pipelines, designing star-schema warehouse layers, tuning production PostgreSQL, controlling BigQuery cost, and running the analytics — segmentation, cohort and retention analysis, time-series forecasting, marketing mix modeling and predictive models deployed on AWS SageMaker. I gather requirements through stakeholder interviews, write the BRDs and technical specifications, and present results to leadership including international clients.

roles.title: Data Analyst Instructor
roles.text: Taught Excel, SQL, Python, data modeling, data warehousing, predictive analytics and Power BI/Tableau in hands-on courses.

roles.text: Managed MySQL databases and ETL processes, and built web applications with JavaScript, React.js and Python.

education.institution: Institute of Business Administration (IBA), University of Dhaka
education.qualification: Advanced Certificate for Management Professionals, ACMP (2025)
education.text: Business analytics alongside the management track — project planning, writing project proposals, team management, strategy, finance and operations. The part I use most is turning a business question into a scoped piece of analytics work with a plan behind it.

The advanced theory and application of everything below. This is where the foundation turned practical: the same mathematics, now deep enough that modeling and programming problems became straightforward rather than intimidating. It is the reason I can work with data confidently today.

Where the base for machine learning and data science was actually built. Linear algebra and statistics sit underneath every model I train; numerical analysis and linear programming underneath the optimisation; and Fortran, Mathematica and MATLAB were my first taste of making a machine do the computation.

projectsIntro: Client work I have led or built at V2 Technologies. These run on production data, so the code and dashboards are not public — what follows is the problem, what I built and the stack. Happy to walk through any of them in detail.

projects.title: EveryAI — AI Subscription App with 500K+ Users
projects.text: Data & Analytics Lead for a multi-model AI app whose users subscribe through telco partners Robi and Cirkle. I own the data work end to end — pipelines, customer segmentation, cohort and retention analysis, and customer and revenue forecasting for planning. The stack routes between models with LiteLLM and keeps embeddings in pgvector for semantic search. Pack-wise revenue reporting runs fully automated in SQL and scheduled Python, down to the generated charts and the emails they arrive in.

projects.title: e-CRM Platform — British American Tobacco Bangladesh
projects.text: Five years on the platform, from analyst to project lead. I am now leading the rebuild of a system that has been running for eight years — redesigning the database and data model to cut running cost and make the pipelines automation-friendly, while keeping data integrity intact through the change. Earlier I was the platform's analyst, working through sales and customer data and building the dashboards used for KPI tracking and customer targeting.

projects.title: e-CRM — Grameenphone Field Operations
projects.text: Designed the data architecture, the BigQuery ETL and the real-time reporting on field market visits and POSM inventory. A Python anomaly detection job flags suspicious field visits into audit tables, delivered to the business as a month-to-date Excel report.

projects.title: Gamified Recruitment Platform (SaaS)
projects.text: Built the data architecture and assessment analytics end to end for our own hiring product, onboarded clients including City Bank and Nagad, and now guide the junior analysts who run it.

projects.title: Univision — Unilever Bangladesh
projects.text: Project lead for two years on the data and analytics work, coordinating between the client and our internal teams, and delivering the reporting their commercial teams work from.
